name: @nocobase/plugin-workflow-approval
description: Open-source approval workflow: trigger by submitting a business record for approval, pause at an approval node for approvers to pass/reject/return, with a task center and AI assistance.
description.zh-CN: 开源审批工作流：提交业务记录发起审批，在审批节点暂停等待审批人通过/拒绝/退回，含任务中心与 AI 辅助。
